answer_1.quote: We selected three widely recognized generation tasks with RAG settings for response generation: Question Answering, Data-to-text Writing, and News Summarization.
answer_1.outputs: The paper reports generated responses from LLMs across multiple tasks, including answers to questions, summaries of news articles, and text generated from structured data.

answer_2.quote: We calculate the overlap between the detected span and human-labeled span and report the precision, recall, and f1 score at the char-level.

answer_3.quote: Hallucination Detection Prompt: Hallucination detection prompts are manually crafted to instruct LLMs (GPT-4-turbo and GPT-3.5-turbo) in assessing whether a given reference-response pair contains hallucinated content and to identify the corresponding hallucinated spans in the response.

answer_4.quote: We recruited annotators from a professional vendor and paid them at a rate of $25 per hour per individual. The annotators are invited to perform annotation tasks using Label Studio.
answer_4.guideline: Their task was to annotate the specific spans of the generated text that contains hallucinated information and categorize them into the four types.
